_comment: Per-session proper-noun table: misheard form -> correct form. Built in stage 0 from the event page, meeting notes and the speaker's own intro, then topped up by scanning the finished transcript. Applied to subtitles only — the audio is never touched. Longer keys must come first: replacement runs in insertion order over the word sequence, so 'GPT image 2.5' has to be listed before 'GPT image'.
_note_on_the_spaces: Whisper splits decimals into two tokens ('2' + '.5'), so a key written the way a human would type it will never match. overlay.py re-joins them before matching, but keep both spellings in the table when in doubt.
_note_on_risk: Never add a mapping whose misheard form is also a normal English word unless it is wrong everywhere in this session — a blanket 'track' -> 'treg' will rewrite legitimate uses of 'track'. Fix those case by case instead.
